attchmntText: Vishnu Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Vishnu Chemicals Limited filed a transcript of the earnings call held on 06th November, 2026, regarding Q2 FY27 financial results. The company reported consolidated operating revenue of INR429.53 crores, a 7.1% year-on-year increase. EBITDA rose 10% to INR64 crores, with a margin of 14.9%. Profit after tax grew 8.2% to INR35.57 crores. Shipping expenses increased to 8.8% of operating revenue due to geopolitical issues in West Asia. The company entered a joint venture with DCX Chrome, France, to establish a 6,000 metric ton per annum high-purity chrome metal facility in Visakhapatnam. Management targets an EBITDA margin of 18% to 19% for the next year. ICRA upgraded the long-term banking facilities rating to A-Stable. The company plans to add 20 MW of solar power capacity.

attchmntText: Vishnu Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Q2FY27 and H1FY27 Earnings Release".
voiceSummary: Vishnu Chemicals Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated operating revenues for Q2FY27 were Rs. 429.5 Cr, a 7.0% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at Rs. 64.0 Cr, up 10.0% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 35.5 Cr, an 8.1% rise. For H1FY27, operating revenues reached Rs. 862.9 Cr, up 15.3%. EBITDA was Rs. 129.4 Cr, up 13.7%. Profit after tax was Rs. 75.2 Cr, up 15.5%. The company entered a 50:50 joint venture with DCX Chrome SAS, France, for a high-purity Chromium Metal facility. Domestic and export sales contributed 58% and 42%, respectively. ICRA assigned an A Stable rating to long-term banking facilities. Consolidated debt-to-equity was 0.67x.
